quests.instruction: What item do we wear with just one little pocket for the thumb, and also on the very coldest days, warmer than regular gloves?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Your fingers snuggle together inside, not separated!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Mittens have one section for your thumb and one large section for all your other fingers.

quests.instruction: What do we call the piece that runs in a neat row down the front of some shirts?
quests.question: Button
quests.hint: It pushes through a tiny hole to close clothes.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Button is a small piece that pushes through a hole to close your clothes!
quests.funFact: Buttons have been used on clothing for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: What do we call the fastener found on shoes for children who are still learning to tie a bow?
quests.question: Velcro
quests.hint: It is fuzzy on one side and hooked on the other.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Velcro is a fuzzy fastener that sticks together with a satisfying rip!
quests.funFact: It was invented after a man noticed how burrs stuck to his dog's fur.

quests.instruction: What do we call the spot where we might keep a coin, a small toy, or a folded note?
quests.question: Pocket
quests.hint: You can tuck a coin or a small toy inside it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Pocket is a small pouch sewn in for holding coins, toys, or notes!
quests.funFact: Pockets were invented to hold coins, keys, and hands to keep them warm.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear that covers our legs and feet all in one thin, stretchy piece?
quests.question: Tights
quests.hint: Think about this: They are thinner than leggings.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Tights are a skin-tight garment that covers the legs from the waist to the toes.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear over our pajamas to stay warm right after a bath?
quests.question: Bathrobe
quests.hint: Think about this: It ties closed with a soft belt.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: A bathrobe is a loose, towel-like coat you wear after taking a shower.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part that can be buttoned tight or left loose and open?
quests.question: Cuff
quests.hint: It is found at the very end of a sleeve.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Cuff is the end of a sleeve that circles snugly around your wrist!
quests.funFact: Shirt cuffs often have buttons or shiny cufflinks to keep them closed.

quests.instruction: What do we call the fastener that closes a jacket faster than doing up many buttons?
quests.question: Zipper
quests.hint: You pull a little tab up and down.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Zipper has tiny teeth that lock together in one smooth pull to close clothes!
quests.funFact: They were originally called 'clasp lockers' when they were invented.

quests.instruction: What do we call the strings that keep our shoes snug and secure on our feet?
quests.question: Shoelaces
quests.hint: You tie these into a bow.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Shoelaces are the strings that tie into a bow to keep your shoes snug!
quests.funFact: You have to tie them in a special knot or bow so they don't come undone.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of a belt, when we want our hands free of adjusting, and also over our shoulders instead of a belt, to hold pants up?
quests.question: Suspenders
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go over your shoulders, not around your waist!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Suspenders clip over your shoulders to hold your pants up without a belt!
quests.funFact: They were invented before belts became popular.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that has short sleeves and pulls over our head?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: Hint: It often has a fun design on the front.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: T-shirts are the most common piece of clothing worn in the world.

quests.instruction: Which word means the spot where a tie is knotted, just below our chin?
quests.question: Collar
quests.hint: Hint: A tie is knotted right below it.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Collar is the folded edge of a shirt that circles your neck!
quests.funFact: A stiff collar helps a shirt look professional and neat.

quests.instruction: Which word means the part that flops down our back when we are not wearing it up?
quests.question: Hood
quests.hint: Hint: A hoodie gets its name from this exact part.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Hood is the part that pulls up over your head to keep rain off!
quests.funFact: Hoods protect your ears and neck from freezing wind and rain.

quests.instruction: What do we wear that hugs our neck closely, almost like a warm little tube?
quests.question: Turtleneck
quests.hint: Hint: It is named after a slow, shelled animal.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your neck for extra warmth!
quests.funFact: The collar can be folded down or scrunched up around the neck.

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear with a front panel and straps that go over our shoulders?
quests.question: Overalls
quests.hint: Think about this: They cover your chest as well as your legs.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Overalls have shoulder straps and a front panel, so they never need a belt!
quests.funFact: They were originally designed as tough workwear for farmers and mechanics.

quests.instruction: What do we wear over a T-shirt when the classroom feels a little chilly?
quests.question: Cardigan
quests.hint: Hint: It is a kind of sweater, but different from one you pull over your head.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Cardigan opens down the front with buttons, making it easy to put on!
quests.funFact: They are usually fastened with buttons or a zipper.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of a jacket, for a bold, heroic look, and also like a superhero wears while flying through the sky?
quests.question: Cape
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It ties at your neck and flows out behind you!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Cape ties at your neck and flows behind you for a bold, heroic look!
quests.funFact: Superheroes are famous for wearing capes in comic books.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of just a coat, for a whole day of playing in deep snow, and also before we go outside to build a snowman or make snow angels?
quests.question: Snowsuit
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It covers your WHOLE body, all in one piece!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Snowsuit covers your whole body in one warm piece for playing in deep snow!
quests.funFact: They are completely waterproof to keep melting snow off your skin.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that buckles snugly under our chin for extra safety, and also on our head to stay safe while riding a bike?
quests.question: Helmet
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It keeps your head safe during sports!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Helmet has a hard shell that protects your head during sports and biking!
quests.funFact: Bicycle helmets are filled with foam that absorbs impact if you fall.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that pulls over our head, thick and cozy like a blanket, and also instead of a hoodie, when we want warmth without a hood?
quests.question: Sweatshirt
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is thick and warm, but has NO hood!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Sweatshirt is thick and warm like a hoodie, but has no hood at all!
quests.funFact: They were originally designed for athletes to wear while exercising.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on a canoe or sailboat, to stay safe near deep water, and also before we get on a boat or go swimming in deep water?
quests.question: Life Jacket
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It helps you float on water!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Life Jacket helps you float safely, worn for water safety near deep water!
quests.funFact: They are designed to keep your head above water if you fall out of a boat.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear over our shirt to protect us from chilly wind?
quests.question: Jacket
quests.hint: Hint: It keeps the wind from making you shiver.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Jacket keeps chilly wind off your body so you stay warm!
quests.funFact: Leather jackets were popularized by pilots in the 1900s.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that stretches and moves easily when we run and jump, and also under a dress or skirt for extra warmth?
quests.question: Leggings
quests.hint: They are stretchy and hug your legs closely!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Leggings are soft and stretchy, moving easily with your legs when you play!
quests.funFact: They are often worn for exercising, yoga, or just being comfortable.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to a wedding or a very special occasion, and also around our collar for a fancy, formal outfit?
quests.question: Tie
quests.hint: It hangs down the front of a shirt!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Tie is knotted at the collar to make an outfit look fancy and formal!
quests.funFact: They are traditionally worn under a shirt collar and knotted at the throat.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on our head on a sunny day?
quests.question: Hat
quests.hint: Hint: You tip this to say a friendly hello.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Hat sits on top of your head to keep it warm or shady!
quests.funFact: Wearing a winter hat stops heat from escaping through your head.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear on our feet that reach up past our ankles?
quests.question: Boots
quests.hint: Hint: They reach up past your ankle.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Boots reach up past your ankle to keep your feet safe and dry!
quests.funFact: Rubber rain boots are entirely waterproof so you can jump in puddles.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear instead of regular clothes before jumping in the water, and also on a hot day when we want to splash and float?
quests.question: Swimsuit
quests.hint: You wear this to go swimming!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Swimsuit is made to get wet and dry quickly for swimming!
quests.funFact: They are designed to be lightweight so they don't drag you down in the water.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear that covers our body in one long piece?
quests.question: Dress
quests.hint: Hint: It can be short or reach all the way to your ankles.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Dress is one piece of clothing that covers your whole body at once!
quests.funFact: Dresses can be casual for summer or highly decorated for formal events.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that buckles snugly at the front, and also through the little loops on the top of our pants?
quests.question: Belt
quests.hint: It goes around your waist!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Belt goes around your waist to keep your pants from slipping down!
quests.funFact: They are usually made of thick leather or strong webbing.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with a hood we pull up to protect our hair, and also on a gray, drizzly, splashy-puddle kind of day?
quests.question: Raincoat
quests.hint: It keeps rain from soaking your clothes!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Raincoat keeps rain from soaking your clothes on a wet, drizzly day!
quests.funFact: They cause rain to bead up and roll right off your body.
